# CloudIcon Studio — Free App Icon Generator

> CloudIcon Studio is a free online app icon generator and editor. Upload once and instantly generate production-ready launcher icons, favicons, mipmaps, adaptive icons, and complete export packs for Android, iOS, Web, and Desktop. 100% client-side — no uploads, no servers, no accounts.

## Key pages

- Home: https://cloudicon.typely.in — Free app icon maker and editor
- Editor: https://cloudicon.typely.in/editor — Online app icon editor with real-time preview
- How It Works: https://cloudicon.typely.in/how-it-works — Step-by-step guide to generating app icons
- Documentation: https://cloudicon.typely.in/docs — Complete documentation for the icon generator
- FAQ: https://cloudicon.typely.in/faq — Frequently asked questions about app icon generation
- Blog: https://cloudicon.typely.in/blog — Articles and updates about app icon design
- About: https://cloudicon.typely.in/about — About CloudIcon Studio
- Contact: https://cloudicon.typely.in/contact — Support and contact information
- Changelog: https://cloudicon.typely.in/changelog — Release notes and version history
- Status: https://cloudicon.typely.in/status — Service uptime and status
- Privacy Policy: https://cloudicon.typely.in/privacy
- Terms of Service: https://cloudicon.typely.in/terms
- Cookie Policy: https://cloudicon.typely.in/cookies
- GDPR Compliance: https://cloudicon.typely.in/gdpr
- CCPA Compliance: https://cloudicon.typely.in/ccpa

## Structured data

The site uses JSON-LD schema.org markup including: Organization, WebSite, WebApplication, SoftwareApplication, HowTo, BreadcrumbList, and FAQPage.

## Features

- Multi-platform icon export (Android, iOS, Web, Desktop)
- GPU-accelerated canvas with real-time rendering and device mockups
- Shape, crop, rotate, background (solid/gradient), and padding tools
- Undo/redo with keyboard shortcuts
- 100% client-side — your images never leave your device
- PWA with offline support
- Adaptive icon generation for Android
- iOS App Store icon sets with Contents.json
- Web favicon and PWA manifest icon export
- Desktop icon export (Windows ICO, macOS ICNS, Linux PNG)
- ZIP export with proper folder hierarchy per platform

## Technologies

Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Fabric.js, Framer Motion, deployed on Vercel.
